blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senator Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan on Wednesday called for the declaration of a national state of emergency amid the adverse effects of the Super El Niño. Pangilinan issued his call during a Senate hearing on the P171.3-billion proposed budget of the Department of Agriculture (DA). READ: El Niño affects over 451,000 people in PH – NDRRMC In his opening statement, Pangilinan noted that the country has already suffered P6.87 in drought losses as of Sept. 26, not yet even including the actual effects of the current El Niño.
